notes.subject: to Daniel
notes.rationale: Yawe (via the messenger) addresses Daniel directly with imperatives.

notes.subject: jɛkolo
notes.rationale: גורל is literally a pebble used for casting lots; rendered as allotted portion.

notes.subject: תנוח
notes.rationale: Rendered as rest/sleep; some read death-rest awaiting resurrection, given תעמד 'stand/arise' following.

notes.subject: laban (the end)
notes.rationale: The sealed end-time is withheld; Daniel is told to go his way without knowing it.

translation: Nka i yɛrɛ, taa ka se laban na, i na sin, awa i bɛna i ka jɛkolo laban donw na jɔ.
